title: Contact with Investors at the Frighteningly Early Stage
primary_theme: Frighteningly early solo GP investing and deep founder engagement
founder_lessons: At frighteningly early stages, investors are underwriting vision, team, and belief before proof exists.
Earn trusted referrals because the person making the introduction is spending social capital.
Seek meaningful engagement with investors who will go deep rather than take superficial meetings.
Build from a problem that keeps nagging you, especially when prior attempts did not solve it well.
notable_quotes: I describe it as frighteningly early, because I have to be frightened in order to make the investment.
The person who is making the introduction is putting some of their social capital on the line when they're making that introduction.
It's been a lot of fun for me to be on both sides of the table and be an investor and also be a founder and CEO at the same time
